headline: Brazil Plans Fiscal Target Legislation Following Market Selloff
summary: Brazil's finance minister announced a new bill to guide the federal budget toward fiscal targets following a recent selloff across domestic financial markets.
why: Investors closely track Brazil's fiscal credibility and deficits, which directly affect the real, sovereign bond yields, and domestic inflation expectations.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: The legislative attempt to enforce fiscal limits seeks to stabilize domestic yields, though execution risk remains.
